channel.title: Snow Dogs: Into The Wild
channel.desc: Gordon arrives in Canada's vast Yukon wilderness to try and master the ancient skill of dog sledding. Inspired by Jack London's novel `The Call of the Wild', it has been Gordon's childhood dream to command a team of dogs out in the Yukon wilderness and follow in the footsteps of the historic Klondike Gold Rush explorers who used this trail. Gordon meets Pierre-Luc Fortin, expert musher and owner of 29 loyal Alaskan huskies, and is introduced to his seven-sled dog team.
